title: Snap Ads Understanding: From Pixels to Words
summary: Our advertising platform at Snap receives a large volume of new ads every day. To maintain a high-quality and relevant ad ecosystem, we need to review these creatives at scale, to ensure they align with our policies, are safe for our community, and are shown to the right Snapchatters.
